exercise1.prompt: print Hello three times with a loop

hiddenCases.name: a loop does the repeating
hiddenCases.describe: a for loop rather than three print statements

exercise1.hint: Three print statements produce the same output and are the thing this lesson is replacing. Ask range(3) to do the counting.

choices: Repeating work without writing it out each time
questions.explain: A loop lets one piece of code handle ten items or ten thousand without being rewritten.

questions.prompt: What is the main difference between while and for?
choices: while repeats until a condition stops being true; for walks through a sequence
questions.explain: Reach for a for loop when you know what you are iterating over, and a while loop when you are waiting for a condition to change.

choices: A loop that runs exactly once
A loop whose stopping condition never becomes true
A loop over an empty list
questions.explain: If nothing inside the loop can make the condition false, it never ends. This is why the auto-grader has a timeout.

questions.prompt: Match each loop to what it is for.
right: Repeat once for each item in a collection
Repeat for as long as a condition holds
questions.explain: A for loop walks something you already have; a while loop runs until a condition changes; break leaves whichever loop you are in.
